defect: The Telegraf JSON snapshot was truncated in place and an OSError during its publication propagated out of ImageWorker.write_status_json before the image was saved.
change: Serialize before touching disk, write a sibling temporary file, close/chmod and atomically replace. Diagnostic OSError is logged and returns normally to image processing.
preserved: No fsync added to regenerable snapshot
targeted_tests: Reader sees previous complete JSON while replacement is held
Byte parity with legacy json.dump formatting
Failed replacement and partial write preserve previous contents and clean temporary file
Actual ImageWorker method continues after diagnostic OSError
Invalid metadata preserves previous snapshot and raises TypeError
installer_check: setup.sh creates VARLIB_FOLDER with mode 775 and capture-user ownership; production directory is eric:eric 775.
limitations: This is correctness/error-isolation work, not a measured disk-latency improvement.
External Telegraf service integration is not claimed; the documented file contract is tested.
